description.content:
List of all dashboards available in authenticated user's organization

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

query.description: A comma separated list of BI folder guids to filter for dashboards within those folders.
A comma separated list of collection guids, for to filter the collection items from
A value to filter by dashboard type.
A comma separated list of data source guids to filter for items within those data sources.
A comma separated list of Data Source Users guids to filter for element creator. Allowed Values include DSUser GUIDs + 'known_users' + 'unknown_users'
A comma separated list of Data Source Users guids to filter for element owner (permission). Allowed Values include DSUser GUIDs + 'known_users' + 'unknown_users'
A boolean to show hidden objects when true and hide hidden objects when false. Defaults to False.
A boolean which filters for newest tables in the organization.
A flag that filters out any table that has a business owner.
A flag that filters out any tables with descriptions
A flag that filters out any table that has a popularity rating.
A flag that shows only assets with no source tables. Only for BI Tools
A flag that filters out any tagged tables
A flag that filters out any table that has a technical owner.

Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.
A comma separated list of user or team guids to filter for objects within these users as owners (technical or business).
A page number within the paginated result set.
Number of results to return per page.
A comma separated list of popularity ranges (inclusive) can include integers from 1-100 ex) 1-10,90-100 would be the bottom 10 percent and the top 10 percent, respectively. Ranges can overlap.
A search term.
Search for an asset using business owner name
Search for an asset using a collection name
Search for an asset using its description
Search for an asset using the name of the creator's user
Search for an asset using the name of the owner's user
Search for an asset using its name
Search for an asset using its raw SQL
Search for an asset using a tag name
Search for an asset using technical owner name
A comma separated list of tag guids
A comma separated list of team guids to filter for tables owned by users of those teams.
A user guid to filter for dashboards created by that user's Data Source users.
A boolean to filter for dashboards which were not successfully run
